;Arts and culture
* The [[E3 2019]] trailer for [[Pokémon Sword and Shield]], scheduled to be released in November, causes controversy and unprecedented unanimous outrage among fans following the announcement that Pokémon absent from the Galar Pokédex cannot be transferred into the games, giving rise to the "Bring Back National Dex" hashtag among fans on [[Twitter]]. [https://www.polygon.com/e3/2019/6/13/18677717/pokemon-sword-shield-national-dex-pokedex-galar-e3-2019 (Polygon)]

;Business and economy
*A committee of the [[United States House of Representatives|US House of Representatives]] announces that it will hold a hearing next Thursday (June 20) to examine [[fuel efficiency]] standards, as the [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]] presses for a rollback of an [[Presidency of Barack Obama|Obama-era]] schedule of 5% reductions in emissions per year. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-autos-emissions/u-s-house-committee-to-hold-hearing-on-proposed-fuel-efficiency-freeze-idUSKCN1TC2T0 (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Sinking of Hableány|Sinking of ''Hableány'']]
**Four bodies are recovered by salvage crews during the raising of the wreck of the ''Hableány'', which sank on the [[Danube]] in Budapest last month. Four other people are still missing. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-48591791 (BBC News)]
*[[2019 North Indian Ocean cyclone season]]
**[[2019 North Indian Ocean cyclone season#Very Severe Cyclonic Storm Vayu|Very Severe Cyclonic Storm Vayu]] is in the [[Arabian Sea]] less than 600 miles south-southeast of [[Karachi]], [[Pakistan]],  and is strengthening as it heads north. Vayu is expected to be a Category 2 or 3 storm  when it approaches the Indian state of [[Gujarat]] early Thursday (local time), then should weaken as it approaches southeastern Pakistan over the weekend. [https://weather.com/storms/hurricane/news/2019-06-10-arabian-sea-tropical-cyclone-vayu-forecast-india-pakistan (The Weather Channel)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/06/cyclone-vayu-threatens-india-pakistan-190611090703282.html (Al Jazeera)]
*A group of 65 [[Rohingya people|Rohingya Muslims]] are left stranded on Rawi Island in southern [[Thailand]] after their boat shipwrecked during a journey to flee [[Rohingya genocide|genocide]] in their native [[Rakhine State]] in [[Myanmar]]. [https://ca.reuters.com/article/topNews/idCAKCN1TC1GX-OCATP (Reuters)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/65-rohingya-muslims-found-shipwrecked-in-southern-thailand/2019/06/11/dbce3794-8c4e-11e9-b6f4-033356502dce_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Asbestos and the law]]
**The [[Congress of Colombia]] unanimously approves a resolution to ban the production, commercialization, and distribution of [[asbestos]]. [https://www.eltiempo.com/politica/congreso/prohiben-uso-del-asbesto-en-colombia-proyecto-paso-ultimo-debate-en-el-congreso-374088 (''El Tiempo'')] 
*[[LGBT rights in Botswana]]
**[[Botswana]] decriminalizes [[homosexuality]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-48594162 (BBC News)]
*[[Media freedom in Russia]]
**Following a public outcry, authorities in [[Russia]] drop drug charges against a journalist, [[Ivan Golunov]], who has earned a reputation for exposing the corruption of [[Moscow]] city officials. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-journalist-free/russia-in-rare-u-turn-after-public-anger-drops-case-against-journalist-idUSKCN1TC1QW (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-48600233 (BBC News)]
*[[Censorship in Samoa]]
**[[Samoa]] bans the film ''[[Rocketman (film)|Rocketman]]'' for its depictions of [[Gay sexual practices|gay sex]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-48593691 (BBC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[North Korea–United States relations]], [[List of North Korean missile tests]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] says he received a "beautiful", "very warm and very nice" letter from [[List of leaders of North Korea|North Korean leader]] [[Kim Jong-un]]. He added that Kim is "keeping his word" and not testing any kind of missiles. Earlier  at a speaking event in Washington, [[National Security Advisor (United States)|National Security Adviser]] [[John R. Bolton|John Bolton]] said North Korea is not complying with the terms agreed upon during Trump's first summit with Kim in [[Singapore]] last year. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-06-11/trump-says-he-got-beautiful-letter-from-kim-but-no-meeting (Bloomberg)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/trump-praises-kim-jong-un-saying-he-received-a-beautiful-letter-from-him/2019/06/11/4359f4d6-8c70-11e9-b08e-cfd89bd36d4e_story.html (''The Washington Post'')] [https://www.cnn.com/2019/06/11/politics/trump-north-korea-kim-jong-un-letter-john-bolton/index.html (CNN)]

;Sports
*[[2019 FIFA Women's World Cup]]
**The [[United States women's national soccer team|USA's]] 13–0 defeat of [[Thailand women's national football team|Thailand]] sets a World Cup record for margin of victory for either men or women, and [[Alex Morgan]]'s five goals ties a tournament record. [https://sports.yahoo.com/usa-womens-world-cup-uswnt-thailand-score-205248875.html (Yahoo! Sports)]
